rationale: EDGAR full-text search + API is a durable public filing source for US-listed payments/banking vendors active in CZ; failed verification is soft.
Statutory procurement gazette continuously produces dated award notices naming vendors, values and bidders.
National open-data catalogue is a standing discovery surface for statutory datasets (ARES, Registr smluv).
Complete bank + associate-member enumeration; mine once for the licensed sector and vendor-adjacent associates.
Working-group roster is a section of cbaonline.cz already covered by monitoring the ČBA parent.
Single instant-payments scheme rulebook PDF: strong evidence artifact, not a recurring signal producer.
Best single enumeration of CZ fintech/payments vendors and their sponsors; mine once, refresh periodically.
Non-bank leasing/consumer-credit/factoring member list adds a distinct payments-IT buyer segment.
580+ e-commerce members and gateways/PSPs: the acquiring-side merchant enumeration; failed check is soft, retry.
Retail/hospitality confederation gives the physical-POS merchant base and points to further associations.
Enumerates the CZ system-integrator bench (Aricoma, Asseco, ICZ, DXC) that competes for banking IT.
Working-group/board page is a sub-section of ictu.cz covered by the member-directory parent.
Internet/adtech membership is only weakly payments-adjacent; revisit if digital-channel vendors matter.
US-linked corporate directory surfaces multinational financial and IT players in CZ.
Smaller UK chamber list with a thin payments tail; low marginal value over AmCham.
Regulator's authoritative index of financial-market associations guarantees completeness of the association layer.
Only PSP-specific CZ association and directly on-topic, but site appears dormant and unreachable; re-check liveness.
Card-payments association members and card-market statistics; legacy site but core to the card vendor field.
Capital-market member list adds investment-firm buyers; secondary to banking/payments core.
Insurer census covers the bancassurance/embedded-payments overlap; peripheral to A6 vendors.
Confederation of sector associations works as an independent cross-check and discovery surface.
Second enumeration of the association layer, largely redundant with ČNB index; URL unverified.
~160 export-oriented CZ ICT firms would sharpen the regional competitor set, but site reachability unconfirmed.
German-firm database identifies German-owned banks, captives and IT suppliers domestic lists miss.
Crypto/CASP association is payment-adjacent under MiCA but small and of unproven membership depth.
Pension and credit-union associations complete the FI census but add few payments vendors; URL unverified.
Annual CARDFORUM partner/sponsor pages give a recurring, dated, paid-commitment read on the CZ card/payments vendor field.
Recurring award programme whose categories and winner releases trace back to the implementing vendors.
